theme: Young investor / first-timer: starting early, small amounts, ₹500/month
headline: Starting your investment journey with small amounts
body: Begin investing early with just ₹500 monthly. Time and consistency build substantial wealth over decades.
caption: Small steps today create big opportunities tomorrow. Every rupee invested grows through the power of compounding over time. Starting early gives your money maximum time to work. #InvestEarly #PowerOfCompounding #SmallStepsLargeFuture #WealthBuilding #YoungInvestor
